name: Montimedia
summary: Ballarat retail ISP/telco (ADSL2+/Naked DSL/dialup/phone/3G/hosting; IIA member); absorbed Cyberspace Corporation's operation c. 2010-11 (cyberspace.net.au 301 by Jan 2011); brand retired into parent More Telecom by May 2026 (montimedia.com.au reduced to a redirect + webmail link).

events.details: Retail ISP site by 2012 (ADSL2+ bundles); cyberspace.net.au (Cyberspace Corporation) already 301-redirecting to montimedia.com.au by 14 Jan 2011.
montimedia.com.au reduced to a 'Redirecting to More Telecom' stub with a webmail-only link by 13 May 2026 (retail brand retired into parent More Telecom).

refs.label: Montimedia stub (13 May 2026): redirecting to parent company More Telecom
